patch.value: Expose freshness and completeness of independent dependency advisory feeds before merge

The2026-10-20 follow-redirects advisories were visible in OSV and the merged-main Scorecard instance while the registry-backed all-dependency audit still reported zero. The component patch is completed separately; this task owns advisory-source freshness and coverage context before merge. Prefer a project-owned assurance collector or extension on existing SDK primitives rather than ecosystem-specific behavior in the generic SDK.

Reuse registered assurance/extension contracts; define bounded queries and explicit provenance for complete project dependency coverage; add a negative control with a lagging zero registry result and positive independent feed, plus unavailable-feed and zero-known-advisory controls; preserve automated updater cooldown and all-severity policy; do not suppress actionable advisories or introduce unbounded polling.

A dependency-security decision exposes source/version/time and coverage receipts, detects a fresh authoritative positive result even when another feed returns zero, and distinguishes unavailable evidence from clean evidence.
